summary_markdown: The conversation focused on reviewing unusual data reported by a colleague (Rafael). Specific concerns included the relationship between reach and viewed impressions, as well as instances where frequency was less than one. The participants discussed checking specific screen inventory (BR-RIO-DD-00007.01, type MUPI) and noted that while general function seemed okay, the location data might be inaccurate based on photo evidence. A plan was established to review a full list of screens for the campaign to correct any incorrect screen types.
decisions: The team will investigate strange data discrepancies reported by Rafael.
A full list of screens from the campaign will be used to identify and correct incorrect screen types.
action_items: Someone needs to provide the complete list of screens for the campaign.
